changeSet.sql: UPDATE parser SET parameters = JSON_SET(parameters, '$.armyPages', CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(parameters, '$.armyPages')) AS JSON), '$.value') AS CHAR)) WHERE dataset_name = 'be_pep_army' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(parameters, '$.armyPages')) LIKE '{"value":%'; UPDATE parser SET parameters = JSON_SET(parameters, '$.organizations', CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(parameters, '$.organizations')) AS JSON), '$.value') AS CHAR)) WHERE dataset_name = 'be_pep_international_orgs' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(parameters, '$.organizations')) LIKE '{"value":%';
